costPenaltyNote: costPenalty is subtracted from an agent's score in routeTask() (lib/collective-brain/index.js) before ranking. Calibrated 2026-09 so free/local agents (opencode, openhuman, anythingllm - no paid model API call) rank ahead of paid model-backed agents (desktop-ai, codex, claude-code) on generic/ambiguous tasks, while a strong keyword match (e.g. 'architecture' for claude-code, 'install'/'windows' for desktop-ai) can still out-rank the cost penalty when the task genuinely needs that agent's specific strength - this is the 'cheapest capable executor first, escalate only when needed' policy, implemented with the existing scoring mechanism rather than a new one.

codex.role: code synthesis, refactoring and test implementation

claude-code.role: architecture review, broad repository reasoning and peer review

openhuman.role: durable workflow orchestration, approvals and memory-aware coordination

anythingllm.role: local knowledge-base Q&A and document/context retrieval over locally-hosted models

sessionPolicy.rule: All executable agent adapters are guarded by shared pre/post hygiene. Unknown/new adapters fail closed until integrated; external desktop/browser sessions use the same required commands.
